name: Perform Chipseq Peak Calling With Macs2
description: Perform ChIP-seq peak calling using MACS2 to identify genomic regions with significant binding.
detailed_description: Perform ChIP-seq peak calling using MACS2 to identify genomic regions with significant binding.
when_to_use: When you need perform chipseq peak calling with macs2 analysis

parameters.chip_seq_file: [Required] Path to the ChIP-seq read data file (BAM, BED, or other supported format) (str)
parameters.control_file: [Required] Path to the control/input data file (BAM, BED, or other supported format) (str)
parameters.genome_size: [Optional] Effective genome size shorthand: 'hs' for human, 'mm' for mouse, etc. (default: hs)
parameters.q_value: [Optional] q-value (minimum FDR) cutoff for peak calling (default: 0.05)
